title: Canonical cocone of stage Cech complexes
statement: Let J be any small category, F:J -> Cat a diagram, V its cocone and P(j), Q precoverages with the canonical functors continuous. Let G(j) be abelian stage sheaves, theta their adjoint presheaf transitions with identity and composition laws, H:J -> Sheaf(Q,Ab), and E(j):H(j) ~= V(j)^-1 G(j). Let beta be the adjunction units followed by E(j) inverse. Suppose beta commutes with theta and H transitions. For any cocone c of H, stage i, family f:T -> F(i) over U and chosen SiteCechComplex S (with T arbitrary, no covering or finiteness condition), there exist the stage complex diagram D, its object identifications eD, a cocone K with point identified by eK with the complex of c.pt restricted along V(i), and the two transition/coprojection projection equations of colimitSite_cech_cocone_exists. This conclusion has no colimit universal property.

source.place: Tag 09YP displayed Cech comparison, expanded with Sites Tags 09YM and 09YN (official tag pages consulted 2026-10-13)

proof.text: Whisker theta along F(a.hom).op and transport targets by F.map_comp and Under.w. These are presheaf transformations m. Their Arrow equations, the identity law of theta, and its composition law verify a presheaf diagram. Transported composites are compared with the proved private arrow_comp_congr helper.

Form gamma from the adjunction unit and E inverse. Whisker gamma followed by c coprojections and transport targets by V.w. Its components are beta followed by the coprojections. To prove the cocone law, use beta compatibility, V.w for endpoint equality, and c.w for the evaluated H transition. Again compare transported Arrow composites.

Apply S.complexFunctor to the presheaf diagram and its cocone. Set eD and eK to identities. In each degree, a product projection after cochainsMap equals the component of the presheaf map after the source projection, by extensionality. Compose the Arrow equations for m and k with these projections to obtain both required equations.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09YP and Sites Tags 09YM, 09YN; explicit Lean interface/argument by Y3

theorem colimitSite_cech_cocone_exists
    {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J]
    (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u}) (P : ∀ j, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    (V : Cocone F)
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [∀ j, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (G : ∀ j, Sheaf (P j).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (θ : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (G j).obj ⟶ (F.map a).toFunctor.op ⋙ (G k).obj)
    (hθid : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j),
      Arrow.mk ((θ j j (𝟙 j)).app (op X)) = Arrow.mk (𝟙 ((G j).obj.obj (op X))))
    (hθcomp : ∀ (j k l : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (b : k ⟶ l) (X : F.obj j),
      Arrow.mk ((θ j l (a ≫ b)).app (op X)) =
        Arrow.mk ((θ j k a).app (op X) ≫
          (θ k l b).app (op ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))))
    (H : J ⥤ Sheaf Q.toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (E : ∀ j, H.obj j ≅
      (sheafPullback (V.ι.app j).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj (G j)) :
    let β := fun (j : J) (X : F.obj j) ↦
      (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app j).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app (G j)).hom.app (op X)) ≫
        (E j).inv.hom.app (op ((V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X))
    (∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j),
      Arrow.mk (β j X ≫ (H.map a).hom.app (op ((V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X))) =
        Arrow.mk ((θ j k a).app (op X) ≫ β k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))) →
    ∀ (c : Cocone H),
    ∀ (i : J) {T : Type u} {U : F.obj i}
      (f : T → F.obj i) (hom : ∀ t, f t ⟶ U),
    ∀ S : SiteCechComplex f hom,
      ∃ (D : Under i ⥤ CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{u} ℕ)
        (eD : ∀ a : Under i, D.obj a ≅
          S.complex ((F.map a.hom).toFunctor.op ⋙ (G a.right).obj))
        (K : Cocone D)
        (eK : K.pt ≅ S.complex ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.op ⋙ c.pt.obj)),
        (∀ (a a' : Under i) (b : a ⟶ a') (p : ℕ) (t : Fin (p + 1) → T),
          Arrow.mk ((eD a).inv.f p ≫ (D.map b).f p ≫ (eD a').hom.f p ≫
            AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Pi.evalAddMonoidHom _ t)) =
          Arrow.mk (AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Pi.evalAddMonoidHom
            (fun t ↦ (G a.right).obj.obj
              (op ((F.map a.hom).toFunctor.obj (S.W p t)))) t) ≫
            (θ a.right a'.right b.right).app
              (op ((F.map a.hom).toFunctor.obj (S.W p t))))) ∧
        (∀ (a : Under i) (p : ℕ) (t : Fin (p + 1) → T),
          Arrow.mk ((eD a).inv.f p ≫ (K.ι.app a).f p ≫ eK.hom.f p ≫
            AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Pi.evalAddMonoidHom _ t)) =
          Arrow.mk (AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Pi.evalAddMonoidHom
            (fun t ↦ (G a.right).obj.obj
              (op ((F.map a.hom).toFunctor.obj (S.W p t)))) t) ≫
            β a.right ((F.map a.hom).toFunctor.obj (S.W p t)) ≫
            (c.ι.app a.right).hom.app
              (op ((V.ι.app a.right).toFunctor.obj
                ((F.map a.hom).toFunctor.obj (S.W p t))))))
